{{Quote|Then we coat the entire hull with this black-chrome sensor-deflector spray somebody found in a highly classified Imperial warehouse.|[[Bolabo Hujaan]]|<ref name="All the Extras">{{WEGCite|book=Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook|story=All the Extras}}</ref>}}
A '''sensor-deflector spray''' was a [[Color/Legends|black]]-[[chrome]] stealth coating that absorbed or deflected most weaker [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] systems at range. It was considered illegal within the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The modified [[YT-2400 light freighter/Legends|YT-2400 light freighter]] [[Outrider/Legends|''Outrider'']]{{'s}} entire [[Hull/Legends|hull]] was coated with the spray.
